title: Build a PTO lookup page in Replit
description: Paste a prompt into Replit Agent to get a private page that answers PTO and benefits questions from your Glean docs.

questions.prompt: What is your work email? It is used once to discover your Glean tenant.
What HR topic do you know your docs cover?

prerequisites: A Replit account with Agent access
A Glean Client API token with the CHAT scope. Create it in Admin Console → API access → Client API tokens, and keep it in Replit Secrets. Every request uses that token owner's access
A private Repl. Multi-user deployments require authenticated per-user Glean OAuth

demoQueries.expectedBehavior: A cited answer from your own HR docs, with a real title and URL.
No fabricated answer when Glean cites nothing. The page shows that it does not know.

codeAssets.description: The exact Replit Agent prompt + secrets checklist

steps.title: Copy your instance name
steps.description: Copy the instance name from the lookup on this page, or from `https://app.glean.com/admin/about-glean`. For `https://acme-be.glean.com` that value is `acme`, not the full URL and not `app.glean.com`. Cookbook plugin users can run `resolve-backend.mjs` with the work email and use the `instance` field.

steps.title: Copy the prompt into a private Repl
steps.description: Click `Copy Replit prompt`. Replace `<your-glean-instance>` with your instance name. Paste the result into a new private Repl at `https://replit.com/new` and open Agent. Cookbook plugin users: the same text is in `replit-agent-prompt.md` next to this skill.

steps.title: Add secrets when Replit asks
steps.description: When Replit Agent asks, add `GLEAN_API_TOKEN` and `GLEAN_INSTANCE` in the Secrets tab, never in the chat. This token is one person's Glean access. Keep the Repl private.

steps.title: Ask a PTO question, then an off-topic one
steps.description: Ask "What is our PTO policy?" and confirm a cited answer from your own docs. Then ask "what's our revenue?" and confirm the assistant does not invent an answer when Glean cites nothing.

aiPrompt: I'm using Cursor, Claude Code, or Codex, not Replit Agent. Do not open Replit. Ask for my work email if needed, run `node <cookbook-plugin-root>/scripts/resolve-backend.mjs "<work-email>"`, and use the instance field from that JSON as GLEAN_INSTANCE. Open replit-agent-prompt.md next to this skill. Replace <your-glean-instance> with that name and set the first suggested question to a natural question about the HR topic they named. Show me the filled prompt so I can paste it into a new private Repl. Remind me GLEAN_API_TOKEN and GLEAN_INSTANCE go in Replit Secrets, never in the prompt. Then walk the remaining steps.
llmContext: Keep this single-user prototype private. Its shared backend token is one service identity, so every request has the token owner's access. Multi-user deployment requires app authentication and per-user Glean OAuth. Keep the token in Replit Secrets, call glean.client.chat.create with USER message fragments, read CONTENT text and fragment.citation.sourceDocument citations, and show cited answers or an explicit no-answer state. GLEAN_INSTANCE is Instance name from https://app.glean.com/admin/about-glean, for example acme.

content.problem:
HR fields the same PTO and benefits questions on repeat. The answers are already in your docs.

This recipe builds a private Replit page that looks those answers up in Glean. Nobody on the team has to write a backend.
takeItFurther: Scope the `CHAT` token even further if your Glean plan supports per-collection tokens, so this tool can only ever answer from HR content.
Compare this to [`no-code-it-helpdesk-lovable`](/cookbook/no-code-it-helpdesk-lovable). Same Chat API call, same constraint that the browser never holds the token, different no-code tool and persona.
Once your team outgrows the no-code version, [`company-answers`](/cookbook/company-answers) shows the same pattern as a hand-written, version-controlled app.
